title: Fukaya categories of Coulomb branches as unique deformations
summary: The symplectic geometry of Coulomb branches is complicated and it is particularly difficult to determine their Fukaya categories. Relative Fukaya categories present an approach to circumvent these difficulties by first computing the Fukaya category of the complement of a divisor and then solving a deformation problem. In this paper, we apply this approach to the specific case of horizontal Hilbert schemes by removing their matter divisor and narrowing down the set of possible deformations through an additional $ \mathbb{Z}^2 $-grading.
